input.command: idle=0; while true; do u=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null || echo 100); if [ "${u:-100}" -lt 5 ]; then idle=$((idle+30)); else idle=0; fi; if [ $idle -ge 120 ]; then echo "GPU idle for 120 s at $(date -u +%H:%M:%SZ): LABELER proof run has likely finished"; exit 0; fi; sleep 30; done
